stemMd: All invoices approved by the director are archived. No archived invoice is missing a reference number. Which statement must be true?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Every archived invoice was approved by the director.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Every invoice approved by the director has a reference number.

options.label: C
options.textMd: No invoice with a reference number is archived.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Some approved invoices lack reference numbers.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Every invoice with a reference number was approved by the director.

explanationMd: Follow the chain: director-approved implies archived, and archived implies not missing a reference number. Therefore approval implies possession of a reference number. Neither implication can simply be reversed.

distractorRationale.a: Archiving may occur for other invoices as well.
distractorRationale.d: The two premises rule this out.
distractorRationale.c: The premises allow and require such invoices when approved.
